distributionArchitecture.tomebound: 69 of its own LeveledItems, injected into merchant chests by quest UDLC01AddMagicItemsQuest (385F60), plus one Dawnguard container edit (DLC1VendorChestFeran 010479). Its five vanilla LVLI overrides add no entries of its own.

vendorMod.eslReason: Tomebound.esp holds 1023 new forms whose local FormIDs run from 00FB02 to 4E870A, every one of them above the 0xFFF ESL ceiling. Flagging it would require FormID compaction, which the pinned toolchain cannot do headlessly (xEdit is blocked on a Delphi 12 licence, TOOLCHAIN.md) and which would also have to remap the references its Immersive Sounds patch makes into it. Not attempted, and not needed: the profile uses only 64 of its 254 full plugin slots, so a full slot is not scarce. The patch itself is ESL-flagged and costs no slot.
